title: FESS Flywheel Rotor Assembly
description: Magnetically-levitated vertical flywheel rotor for a Flywheel Energy Storage System. Designed for high-speed rotation with balanced mass distribution, integrated magnetic-bearing seats, and a composite-ready rim profile for kinetic energy storage.

title: Conveyor Drive Gearbox
description: Two-stage helical reduction gearbox driving an industrial IIoT conveyor line. Models the housing, shafts, bearings, and meshing gear train with a target reduction ratio tuned for continuous-duty belt throughput.

title: Centrifugal Pump Impeller
description: Closed-type centrifugal impeller with backward-curved vanes, modelled for a mid-head process pump. Vane geometry is profiled for smooth flow transition and reduced cavitation risk at the design operating point.
